base_member_text: the comment '% 60 times' (L3) does not explain that dx=1/60 degree = 1 arcminute; RI y2 comment (L71) admits the range end is not hit exactly
audit_member_text: The colon grids do not guarantee inclusion of the requested upper bound when `(x2-x1)/dx` or `(y2-y1)/dx` is nonintegral. The RI definition itself notes y2=42.246666... but y(end)=42.233333 at L71; the NC latitude span L10-L14 is also not an integer number of `dx` steps, so the generated north side is below the declared y2.

base_member_text: sta columns are (lat, lon, side_id) — column 1 is latitude, column 2 longitude (L21-L22); consumers must know this order, and the coupling scripts read only column 3

corner points are duplicated between adjacent sides (east/west loops span all y including y(1) and y(end) which also appear in south/north loops); whether the FUNWAVE STATIONS output expects deduplicated corners is not determinable here
the NC block plot (L57) plots all rows accumulated so far, correct only because NC is first; RI/FL plots slice by icount_last

audit_member_text: Each side loop includes both corners (L19-L51 and repeated blocks), intentionally matching the displayed total formula 2*length(x)+2*length(y) at L53 but duplicating each physical corner under two side ids; the file contains no explicit statement whether downstream coupling expects duplicated corners.
The three plot writes assume a pre-existing `plots` directory (L61,L121,L180), and the final fopen result is not checked before fprintf (L183-L185).
